description: This Java class defines configuration properties for the Kura adapter, including content types and control prefix used for messaging.

classes.name: KuraAdapterProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties for the Kura adapter, extending MQTT protocol adapter properties, including control message content types and prefix.

methods.name: getControlPrefix
methods.description: Returns the control prefix used to identify control messages.

methods.name: setControlPrefix
methods.description: Sets the control prefix used to identify control messages.

methods.name: getCtrlMsgContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type used for Kura control messages.

methods.name: setCtrlMsgContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type used for Kura control messages.

methods.name: getDataMsgContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type used for Kura data messages.

methods.name: setDataMsgContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type used for Kura data messages.
